comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
CA]Alianore already explained about this a while ago in fan group regarding rare item drops in Noble Seas Ticket, however since not everyone in that group, i guess it's safe to list them here.. this is straightly taken from her post.

- Riding Suit
- Trident
- Chef's Clothing Trunk
- British Detective's Clothing Trunk
- Bridal Clothing Trunk
- Special British Item Purchase Order
- Rewards from a Famous Admiral
- Steam Engineer Clothes Trunk (Info : Steam Engineer Clothes Trunk)
- Steam Engineer's Weapon Box
- Alchemist Storage Book (I believe you can get Forbidden Alchemist Book from this as my friend had this and got two)
- Special Adventurer Clothes Trunk
- Special Weapon Ticket
- New World Box (Info : New World Box)
- Cat Gloves (I remember well you put information about this somewhere..)

Other than that, the drop is Exp/Fame/Skill Prof charm and it is very likely to get them more. Sadly there isn't many info about those items in list so i'll just leave them to rest of you spenders to figure out lol or maybe PP have the info about those in previous cove list.. i'm not sure

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Thanks, it's better to have the info in a more public place than just a fan group. (And yeah, I did add the cat gloves, but then wondered if I was misinformed since I don't use the noble tickets.)

For those that wander here now: I figured this was as good a place as any to keep Noble Seas Ticket drops listed on the DB, until its actual ticket item is translated and more easily found. A better list exists than the one I had, so I deleted the original one for clarity. Cheers.
